title: Length of a list block
statement: Let $l$ be a list and let $K,c,i$ be natural numbers. If $l$ has length $Kc$ and $i<K$, then the block obtained by dropping the first $ic$ elements of $l$ and taking the next $c$ elements has length $c$.
